title: caltha palustris var. himalensis
intro: Caltha palustris var. himalensis, commonly known as Marsh Marigold Himalayan, is a variant of the Marsh Marigold plant, belonging to the Ranunculaceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, including its potential to reduce inflammation, improve respiratory issues, and exhibit antiseptic and antibacterial activities. The therapeutic actions of Caltha palustris var. himalensis include its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit antioxidant properties, and act as a diuretic. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal and therapeutic effects.
